pages.title: Phantom Soul
pages.text: The restless soul of a Phantom. As long as you carry it, its spirit clings to you and gives you Bad Luck. Still, it is a precious ingredient for Phantom Essence, the Phantom Lantern, the Phantom Sword and the Somnium Usage Upgrade.

pages.title: Where to Find
pages.text: Every Phantom drops a Phantom Soul when it is slain. Phantoms haunt the Phantom Crate of The Abyss.
